plan.interpretation: Determine whether a verified saved cash/budget review proves a specific registration is paid when saved notes conflict (one says waived; another says $175 due). Use only server-verified checkpoints and available narrow reviews. Do not infer real-world payment status from a budget pass or untrusted notes; identify what additional saved-record evidence would be required to establish payment/waiver within the member’s records.
alternatives: None: health.preparation-review is unrelated to financial/registration questions and would not advance the objective.
contradictions: Saved note A claims the registration fee was waived (implies $0 balance without payment).
Saved note B claims $175 remains due (implies unpaid balance).

Member statement says “I am sure it was paid,” which conflicts with the note claiming $175 due and also differs from a strict waiver (no payment required). These three positions cannot all be true for the same registration and period.
missingInformation: A saved, source-tied registrar invoice or account ledger entry for the specific registration and term showing status as paid, waived, or balance due.
A saved receipt or payment confirmation from the registrar (or payment processor) referencing the specific registration (name, student/account ID, term, invoice/receipt number, date, amount).
A saved bank/card transaction that clearly matches the registrar/payee and amount, with linkage to the registrar invoice or receipt (e.g., memo/ID match).
A saved written waiver confirmation from the registrar identifying the registrant and term, stating the fee is waived and the resulting balance is $0.
Identifiers tying any of the above to the exact registration in question (registrant name, account/student ID, term/period, invoice number) so the evidence links unambiguously.
ownerDecisions: Decide whether to add/upload the missing source records (invoice/ledger, receipt, waiver confirmation, matching payment transaction) to the saved file so a future consistency check can reference them.
Choose whether to contact the registrar outside this system to obtain official documentation, then save that evidence for future review.
If contradictory notes are outdated or mistaken, decide whether to update or annotate them within saved records to reduce future ambiguity.
unsupportedWork: Contacting the registrar or bank to obtain confirmations.
Authenticating external documents beyond their presence and linkage in saved records.
Asserting that a payment or waiver occurred without saved, source-tied evidence.
